The earlier schedule view may be stale.

feedback.reason: The overlap check and insertion must observe the same current meter schedule. Conditional insertion prevents two callers from claiming the final interval after separate safe reads.

options.text: Insert only if the current meter schedule has no overlapping interval.
Read safely, check overlap in the client, then add in another call.
Accept the interval and remove collisions in a later reconciliation.
Confirm using the reservation screen’s earlier schedule read.

prompt: In A neighborhood energy-sharing service, A meter schedule stores reservations in a collection. The system must reject any new interval that overlaps an existing one; two requests can race after each has read the same schedule. Which operation makes the stated collection-level contract reliable?
